card.title: Drones for Deliveries
card.passage: Today, some companies are testing drones to deliver goods. Drones can fly over roads and rivers, and in this way they can reach places that are hard to get to by car. Companies hope that drones will help people living in mountain areas. However, drones can be affected by bad weather, so companies need to make sure they can fly safely.

bubbles.t: Let's go to Okinawa this summer!

panels.cap: On the day of the trip

card.start: One day, Mr. and Mrs. Sato were talking about their summer vacation.

steps.t: Hello. My name is Ms. Brown. May I have your name, please?
Thank you. This is the Grade 2 test. OK? How are you today?
Let's start the test. Here is your card.
First, please read the passage silently for 20 seconds.
All right. Now, please read it aloud.
Now, I'll ask you four questions.
Number 1. According to the passage, how can drones reach places that are hard to get to by car?
Number 2. Now, please look at the pictures and describe the situation. You have 20 seconds to prepare. Your story should begin with the sentence on the card.
Now, please turn over the card and put it down.
Number 3. Some people say that families should spend more time together. What do you think about that?
Number 4. Today, many people buy things on the Internet. Do you think online shopping will become more popular in the future?
This is the end of the test. Could I have the card back, please?
Thank you. You may go now.

points: and in this way / However, の前で区切る
内容のまとまりを意識して

q1.q: According to the passage, how can drones reach places that are hard to get to by car?
q1.ja: ドローンはどうやって車で行きにくい場所に届くことができますか。
model: By flying over roads and rivers.
points: in this way の前を答える

q2.ja: 3コマのイラストの話を、カードの最初の文から説明してください。
model: One day, Mr. and Mrs. Sato were talking about their summer vacation. Mrs. Sato said to her husband, "Let's go to Okinawa this summer!" A week later, Mr. Sato was booking plane tickets on his computer, and Mrs. Sato was packing a suitcase. On the day of the trip, they were at the airport. They found out that their flight had been canceled because of a typhoon.
points: 2人がそれぞれしていることを説明
過去完了(had been canceled)も使えると◎

q3.q: Some people say that families should spend more time together. What do you think about that?
q3.ja: 家族はもっと一緒に過ごすべきだという意見について、どう思いますか。
model: I agree. Spending time together helps family members understand each other. For example, they can talk about their problems during dinner.
I disagree. Many people are busy with work and school. It is more important for families to enjoy the time they have together.
points: I agree / I disagree で立場を

q4.q: Do you think online shopping will become more popular in the future?
q4.ja: 将来、ネットショッピングはもっと広まると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → It is convenient because people can buy things at any time. Also, delivery services are getting faster.
model.no: No. → Many people want to see products before they buy them. They also enjoy shopping with their friends at stores.
